Edit: Not much new content, I'm mainly updating to prevent the gallery from being locked since it has been almost a year.

I originally just got asked to translate a story from https://e-hentai.org/g/1363217/3b013311ad/, but I figured I might as well do the whole thing, so here we are.

This includes all the Twitter content from the artist, except for:
- Images without text that are already in the previous gallery (so more or less February 2019 and before)
- Most of the samples from paid content.

Images up to page 451, along with pages 648, 780 and 845 were translated by me, the rest are from the artist.

Mostly by order of release with the images from the same story put together.
